title: LISTEN: ‘Minions and Monsters’ Has Tepid U.S. Opening as ‘Young Washington’ Impresses; Why Comcast’s Sky is Buying ITV
content:
'Daily Variety' podcast dives into news, trends and personalities making headlines in showbiz

ByCynthia Littleton

Business Editor

Variety’s Rebecca Rubin breaks down a muted July 4th holiday weekend at the box office witha tepid U.S. opening for Universal and Illumination’s “Minions and Monsters”but a solid turnout for indie Angel Studios’ “Young Washington.” AndVariety‘s K.J. Yossman explains whyComcast’s Sky has struck a deal to buy U.K. broadcaster ITVfor $2.1 billion.

For “Minions and Monsters,” the good news is that the film is already performing well in several overseas territories. Domestically, however, it registered the lowest opening weekend of the “Despicable Me” franchise to date with $36 million.

“It might be a little bit of a case of franchise fatigue,” Rubin says. “This is a franchise that tends to be pretty popular overseas. It opened last weekend in a few territories, and so the movie has made around $160 million globally so far. And so it’s hard to knock that kind of business, because [‘Minions’] doesn’t have the biggest production budget compared to some other animated properties like the ‘Toy Story’ movies are much more expensive. This one cost $85 million. So it’s definitely a disappointing start, especially at the domestic box office. But it’s not necessarily a big financial wipeout.”

“Young Washington” is an independently produced biopic of George Washington that was a hit with the heartland and values-driven audiences that Angel Studios courts with its movie and TV productions. The modestly budgeted film grabbed $20 million in its opening salvo.

Angel Studios “have a niche that they have found with this demographic. They definitely know their core audience,” Rubin says. “And the moviegoers who tend to see these films often give them very good audience scores. This one had an A grade, and that usually bodes well for how it’s going to do over its run. It’s another win for Angel Studios.”

Yossman, a London-based reporter forVariety, breaks down the $2.1 billion transaction unveiled today between Comcast’s Sky andITV. Comcast will acquire the linear broadcast network and the ITVX streaming platform while the ITV Studios arm will remain a standalone publicly traded company owned by ITV shareholders. It’s a huge shakeup and a sign of the times for the U.K. TV sector, where local players are finding it increasingly difficult to go it alone without broader media partnerships.

“What I’m hearing from everybody is the landscape has completely changed. The threat now is from these American giants, the social media giants whether it’s or Meta or Google, YouTube, Netflix, and that it is a completely different landscape,” Yossman says. “The signs are that the government, in its current form, will be quite supportive of these kinds of mergers and acquisitions, because the main goal is obviously to keep at least the [public service broadcasters] as a going concern. And if it has to be sold to an American studio to do that, it’s still better than the alternative, which is for it to go bust.”

Comcast last week unveiled a plan to separate the core Comcast cable and technology assets from NBCUniversal and Sky. The ITV acquisition feels like the second half of that deal, as Yossman notes.

“Our sense is that is really where the value for them is for the streaming platform, ITVX,” she says.

(Pictured: “Young Washington”)

《每日變化(Daily Variety)》播客深入探討娛樂圈的新聞、趨勢和引人注目的人物

作者：辛西婭·利特爾(Cynthia Littleton)

商業編輯

《變化(Variety)》的瑞貝卡·魯賓(Rebecca Rubin)分析了美國電影市場在七月四日假期的低迷表現，環球影業(Universal)和照明娛樂(Illumination)的《小小兵與怪獸(Minions and Monsters)》開局平淡，但獨立製片公司天使影業(Angel Studios)的《年輕的華盛頓(Young Washington)》卻吸引了穩定的觀眾。另一方面，《變化(Variety)》的K.J. 約斯曼(K.J. Yossman)解釋了康卡斯特(Comcast)的天空(Sky)為何以21億美元收購英國廣播公司ITV的交易。

對於《小小兵與怪獸》，好消息是該片在幾個海外市場的表現良好。然而，在美國市場上，該片的開幕週末收入僅為3600萬美元，創下《神偷奶爸(Despicable Me)》系列的最低開幕紀錄。

瑞貝卡·魯賓表示：“這可能有點像是系列疲勞的情況。這是一個在海外相當受歡迎的系列。它上週末在幾個地區上映，因此到目前為止，這部電影在全球的票房已經達到約1.6億美元。所以很難對這樣的業務提出批評，因為《小小兵》與其他一些動畫作品相比，並沒有那麼高的製作預算，例如《玩具總動員(Toy Story)》系列的成本要高得多。這部電影的成本是8500萬美元。因此，這個開局確實令人失望，尤其是在美國市場上。但這並不一定是一個巨大的財務失敗。”

《年輕的華盛頓》是一部獨立製作的喬治·華盛頓(George Washington)傳記電影，受到天使影業所吸引的心地善良和價值觀驅動的觀眾的喜愛。這部預算不高的電影在首映時獲得了2000萬美元的票房。

瑞貝卡·魯賓說：“天使影業在這個受眾群體中找到了自己的利基市場。他們對自己的核心觀眾非常了解。而這些觀眾通常會給這些電影非常高的觀眾評分。這部電影得到了A級評價，這通常預示著它在上映期間的表現會很好。這對天使影業來說又是一個勝利。”

K.J. 約斯曼作為《變化(Variety)》的倫敦記者，分析了今天康卡斯特(Comcast)的天空(Sky)與ITV之間的21億美元交易。康卡斯特將收購這個線性廣播網絡和ITVX串流平台，而ITV Studios部門將保持獨立，成為由ITV股東擁有的上市公司。這是一個重大的變革，顯示了英國電視行業的時代變遷，當地的參與者發現越來越難以單打獨鬥，而不依賴更廣泛的媒體合作夥伴關係。

“我聽到的每個人都說，形勢已經完全改變。現在的威脅來自這些美國巨頭，社交媒體巨頭，不論是Meta或是Google、YouTube、Netflix，這是一個完全不同的格局，”約斯曼(Yossman)表示。“跡象顯示，政府在目前的形式下，將會相當支持這類合併和收購，因為主要目標顯然是讓至少公共服務廣播公司能夠持續運營。如果必須將其出售給美國工作室來實現這一點，那仍然比其破產要好。”

康卡斯特(Comcast)上週公布了一項計劃，將核心的康卡斯特有線電視和技術資產與NBC環球(NBCUniversal)和天空(Sky)分開。約斯曼指出，收購ITV感覺像是該交易的下半部分。

“我們的感覺是，這對他們的串流平台ITVX來說，才是真正的價值所在，”她說。

（圖片： “年輕的華盛頓”）
